articles.title: From a Basement to Billboard: Ms. Rachel's First Album Drops Sept. 25
articles.summary: Ms. Rachel — the pink-headband YouTube star with 17.2 billion views — is releasing her debut album, "I'm So Happy," on Sept. 25. The 23-song record features real instruments, including cello, and she says kids deserve rich music.

articles.title: Early Voting Kicks Off as Midterms Could Flip Congress
articles.summary: In-person early voting began Friday in Virginia, with Idaho, Minnesota and South Dakota also opening absentee voting. The Nov. 3 midterms will decide control of Congress, with voters citing grocery prices and the war in Iran.

articles.title: UEFA and CONCACAF Challenge FIFA: Give $2.1 Billion to Member Nations
articles.summary: UEFA's Aleksander Ceferin and CONCACAF's Victor Montagliani want FIFA to pay each of its 211 member associations at least $10 million — about $2.1 billion total — from reserves they say will hit $6 billion.
